blurb: Colina Park Golf Course is an 18-hole, par-3 course with holes ranging from 54 to 109 yards, featuring elevated tee boxes and contoured greens. The course includes 11 bunkers, 2 lakes, and waterfalls, and offers a driving range, chipping and bunker area, and a practice putting green. Both ball golf and disc golf are available, with lessons from PGA professionals and equipment rentals.
extraNote: Tee times can be booked up to 7 days in advance · Walk-ons not guaranteed, disc golf walk-ons not accepted during peak times · Facility closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas · Bonus Value Card non-refundable, no cash value, applies to greens fees only · Allow faster groups to play through to maintain pace of play
